name: Albert Lancaster
original_name: アルバート・ランカスター
source:
[i]"You must rescue the prince without a second's delay!"[/i]

[b]Occupation:[/b] King of Hemeria
[b]Interest:[/b] Health

The king of Hemeria, full of the energy and vigor befitting the land of the sun. He is terribly upset when his son, Prince Roderick, is kidnapped, and assigns Garrett on a mission to retrieve him.

[From [url=https://products.voltage.co.jp/redbell/english/characters/?page=albert]Voltage Inc.[/url]]
